standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' one entry; no split entries; 42 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) with a prominent reinforcing strong anionic Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (C3b: ether/sulfonate class); buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5. C3b laureth-8 limit applies: read as a buffer instead, the chassis would be C1 moderate, so confidence is at most moderate and the neighbor is moderate. Further ether sulfates (Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @12, Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate @13, Sodium Oleth Sulfate @14, Magnesium Oleth Sulfate @17) are after the E3 point and not counted (C4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning polymer is Polyquaternium-10 @18 after the E3 point; no silicone, no payload lipid; PEG-3 Distearate @3 is a pearlizer/opacifier, not a conditioning system. Counter-signal: Polyquaternium-10 plus pearlizer could give light slip; neighbor moderate.

reset: strong anionic ether Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2, Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (prominent)
excluded: PEG-3 Distearate @3 (pearlizing PEG ester, excluded like glycol distearate, 6.4)
Hamamelis Virginiana Water @23 and botanical extracts @30-35 (extracts)

wLineRecord.note: Piroctone Olamine @8: (i) surfactants before it; (ii) only Phenoxyethanol @9 and Citric Acid @10 before the cap. No payload_lipid in the formula, so the W-line gates nothing.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Polyquaternium-10 can deposit at low dose.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single light cationic polymer listed late (@18, after Parfum) faces a strong reinforced ether-sulfate chassis; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate needs at least one plausible persistent depositing system; a single late Polyquaternium-10 facing strong reset is not one (single family, no polymer floor, W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: none material: one late family, strong reset
weightPotential.rationale: low: one late light polymer vs strong reset (6.6, W2).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; no repair or moisture cluster

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Caffeine @19 is a hair-loss-type ingredient, never a focus route (F5); Piroctone Olamine @8 makes scalp_active compatible only with dandruff positioning.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular: treatment if a qualifying dandruff claim appears (U3, active present); alternating if strong plus reset intent (U4); frequent is impossible while cleansing is strong.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: not_targeted regardless of positioning: CSA fails, no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (Allantoin @16 and Niacinamide @26 are after the E3 point @11; Propylene Glycol is not a listed route); strong cleansing is a counter-signal. Even explicit sensitive positioning could not make it targeted.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: Piroctone Olamine @8 in a complete formula (Section 11).

strongAnionicEther: Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (reinforcing; C3b high-EO counter-signal)
Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @12, Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate @13, Sodium Oleth Sulfate @14, Magnesium Oleth Sulfate @17 (not prominent)
surfactantClasses.c4: defining SLES @2; reinforcing Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4; buffer CAPB @5

uncertainties: cleansingStrength strong vs moderate hinges on reading Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 as a strong anionic (C3b); recorded moderate confidence, neighbor moderate as C3b requires.
